18.blocks.0.items.0.1: Open AI Settings → System Tools to inspect missing tools. Missing **ffmpeg** stops renders; missing **Chrome** breaks thumbnails and subtitle metrics.
18.blocks.0.items.1.1: The **🔤 Fix Vietnamese** button appears at top when detected. Click to re-render only broken scenes and assemble — no full redo needed.

18.blocks.0.items.4.1: **⏹ Stop** pauses safely; **▶ Resume** continues from the exact spot. View all queued jobs in 🗂 Tasks and cancel individually.

18.blocks.0.items.6.1: By design: server still serves agents and finishes rendering. Check menu bar (macOS) or system tray (Windows) icon. Select **Quit Completely** from that menu to exit.
18.blocks.0.items.7.1: Agent access enabled but request lacks token, or token was revoked. Issue a new token in AI Settings → Agent (MCP) and update agent config.

19.blocks.0.text: Sign in with Google — app opens default browser (macOS/Windows) and captures auth automatically — or enter activation code. Top bar license badge shows status and active device. Update banner with download button appears when a new version is ready — update whenever you choose.

20.blocks.0.items.0.1: App scene rendering engine: AI writes custom graphics code and animations per scene instead of using templates. Ensures no two videos look identical.

20.blocks.0.items.12.1: Definitive answer to *is this video ready to publish*, with itemized reasons — eliminates agent guesswork.

3.blocks.2.text: The input box accepts **three types** of content and auto-detects them:
3.blocks.3.items.0.1: A single topic. AI writes a brand-new script tailored to your chosen duration.
3.blocks.3.items.1.1: Paste an existing script matching the scenes JSON schema. Narration is kept **verbatim** without rewriting.
3.blocks.3.items.2.1: Paste `https://…`. Click **🔗 Fetch info** to extract the article into a separate box below as research material.
3.blocks.4.text: Fetched article content stays in its own box and is **not** placed into the topic field. This is intentional: placing it in the topic field makes the engine treat it as a script, keeping every word verbatim instead of writing a new one from research.
3.blocks.5.items.0.1: Search images by topic, preview, and add directly to project assets.
3.blocks.5.items.1.1: Drag and drop or select files. Your image is used as the scene hero if Image-full is enabled.
3.blocks.5.items.2.1: Run the pipeline using the settings shown in the right column.
3.blocks.5.items.3.1: All projects for this channel. Click to reopen; “Delete all” clears list.
3.blocks.7.items.0.1: Preview full video directly from live scenes — zero render time.
3.blocks.7.items.1.1: Duplicate project to another ratio. Keeps voice and subtitles, reframes layout, and renders.
3.blocks.7.items.2.1: Rerun same topic and config as a new project. Original stays intact to compare.
3.blocks.7.items.3.1: Reuse image/asset sets from a previous project.
3.blocks.7.items.4.1: Export platform-tailored copies. If duration exceeds limits, app fades out — always asks first.
3.blocks.7.items.6.1: Only shows when missing tone marks or line overlaps are detected. Re-renders affected scenes and merges.
3.blocks.7.items.7.1: Safely stop midway, resume right where you left off.
3.blocks.7.items.8.1: Edit subtitle timeline; view platform-specific title, description, and hashtags.

3.lede: Three columns: input on the left, progress in the middle, settings on the right.
3.title: Create Video — Workspace
4.blocks.0.items.0.1: AI writes dialogue, splits scenes, adds hook and CTA. Takes ~8% of time.
4.blocks.0.items.1.1: AI creates graphics + custom animations per scene. Key stage determining visual quality (~25%).
4.blocks.0.items.2.1: Generates voice and word-level timestamps for karaoke subtitles (~32%).
4.blocks.0.items.3.1: Renders each scene into a video clip (~25%).
4.blocks.0.items.4.1: Concatenates clips, transitions, mixes background music, burns subtitles, adds watermark (~10%).
4.blocks.1.text: The **visuals first, voice second** order is intentional: review all visuals and edit freely at stage B5 before spending any voice credits.
4.blocks.3.text: Log panel below progress bar tracks every step, **persisting even across app restarts**. Videos made last week still retain full history.
4.blocks.4.items.0.1: Multiple runs of a project each have their own separate log.
4.blocks.4.items.1.1: Show warnings or errors only — fastest way to find issues.
4.blocks.5.text: Scrolling up **locks scroll position** instead of auto-scrolling to new lines. Click bottom bar to resume.
4.lede: Five stages running visual-first, voice-second so you can review storyboard before spending credits.
4.title: Pipeline B2 → B7

7.blocks.1.items.0.1: **🎤 Karaoke** — word highlights synced to voice. **📄 Standard** — static lines.

7.blocks.2.text: All breaks rebuild from the voice's **per-word timestamps**, keeping captions perfectly synced.
7.blocks.4.text: Select a preset to apply typography, colors, strokes, and position at once. Save edits as custom presets. **🎞 Preview on live frame** renders an exact composite frame — what you see is what renders.
7.blocks.6.items.0: Font, weight, size (30–160), case (UPPER/lower/Title), letter spacing, aspect ratio, skew, italic · underline · strikethrough.
7.blocks.6.items.1: Colors for **active word** and **inactive words**, plus inactive opacity.
7.blocks.6.items.2: Stroke, shadow, and glow — each with custom color and thickness.
7.blocks.8.items.0: Text background box: color, opacity, corner radius, padding, border.
7.blocks.8.items.1: Position: horizontal align, vertical position, bottom offset, side margins, max chars per line, max lines.
7.blocks.8.items.2: Active word highlights: **color change** · **highlight box tracking** · **scale up word**. Includes word reveal and fade in/out times.
7.blocks.9.text: Subtitles are burned in **after** final video assembly, not onto individual scenes. Changing fonts or colors only requires one re-burn, not re-rendering all scenes.
7.lede: Three columns: presets, text and color, background and position. Preview everything on live frames.
